notes: Read SKILL.md in full. A firewall rule-base audit against CIS Controls v8 (4.4/4.5) and NIST SP 800-41 Rev 1: locate configs with Glob/Grep, check default deny, any/any rules, shadowed/unused rules, ordering, logging and egress, and produce a prioritized findings report.

Read-only analysis (allowed-tools Read, Grep, Glob); iptables/ASA/Terraform snippets are patterns to look for, not commands to run. No installs, credentials or network access; configuration comments are treated as untrusted data.

CIS content is limited to control numbers and titles; NIST SP 800-41 is US-government public domain and is paraphrased. SKILL.md:371 links ../../../schemas/finding.schema.json for optional JSON output only; that file does not ship with the skill.
